datasets.description: Prepared directly from official TCGA Agilent Level 3 measurements hosted by the NCI GDC. Contains 533 primary tumors, three metastatic tumors, 17,322 complete gene expression predictors, and response y (BRCA1 expression). Values are log2 lowess-normalized Cy5/Cy3 ratios collapsed by gene symbol. Retains official precision, gene symbols, and sample identifiers, with no extra centering or imputation. Samples and predictors are sorted lexicographically. The public sample_id is metadata excluded from model features. Iowa's added gene annotations are omitted.

license.evidence: Official TCGA open-access Agilent Level 3 measurements, retrieved from the NCI GDC publication archive. GDC policies permit analysis and publication of open-access data, require attribution, and prohibit attempts to reidentify participants. This automated review treats publishing the portable numeric extract as publication under those source policies. No SPDX license or public-domain dedication is inferred. Iowa's RDS and added annotations are not preparation inputs.

datasets.description: Prepared from the authors' GSE5680 processed RMA expression matrix. Contains 120 F2 rats from an SR/JrHsd x SHRSP intercross, with 18,985 expression predictors and response y (Trim32 probe 1389163_at). Retains GEO numeric precision, sample identifiers, and source sample and probe order, without additional normalization or imputation. After excluding 57 AFFX controls, selection keeps probes whose maximum exceeds the global first quartile and whose range is at least one on the log2 scale, following the paper's rule at full precision. This retains 10 predictors beyond Iowa's rounded export. sample_id is metadata excluded from model features. Added gene annotations and experimental controls are omitted.

license.evidence: GEO places no restrictions on use or distribution of submitted data, while warning that submitters may retain intellectual property rights. No additional data-specific restriction was found in GSE5680 or its sample records. This review treats GEO's source terms as the redistribution basis for this numeric extract, retaining attribution. No SPDX license or public-domain dedication is inferred. Iowa's RDS, code, and added annotations are not preparation inputs.
